integrity: The theorem is supported by an explicit all-size bijective proof; the embedded exact enumerator is supplemental. The literature comparison and review are not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Uniform Dyck paths and area defined by up-step starting heights only; no claim for general weighted excursions, other peak heights, or independence in the explicit coupling. Earlier area-bijection literature might imply an equivalent statement; Pergola 2001 full text was inaccessible.
title: Hill-size bias lowers area in uniform Dyck excursions
